name.zh: 阿卡迪亚与希尔法幸存者

periods.description: Old-era survivors rescued from ruins by Ariel, including Arcadia and Sylfa lineage children. They are sheltered mainly at the Seventh Ruins Moon and are being raised to adapt to the modern era.
periods.history: Hidden in ruins since the old era until Ariel began decoding ruins records and rescuing them.
periods.goals: Survive, adapt to the current era, and find places to belong outside the ruins.
periods.structure: Child survivor community under Ariel and Sophis's guardianship, with Li Prica as a leader among the children.
